title: Man Posing on Bridge, 1955 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-1950s black and white square snapshot showing a man standing on a bridge with hands on his hips. He wears a patterned short-sleeved collared shirt and light trousers. A river and dense foliage are visible behind him. The top border carries a photo-lab date stamp reading 'AUG 55', reflecting post-war casual leisure in America.
